label: Lipocalin-2 perpetuates postoperative and post-infectious neuroinflammation and anxiety-like behavior.
summary: Lipocalin-2 (LCN2) is a pleiotropic cytokine with well-established roles in immune defense, iron metabolism, and inflammation that has been used as a biomarker for kidney injury, cancer, and infection. Recent work has also suggested a role for LCN2 in brain function and behavior, suggesting that LCN2 excess could be a driver of neuropsychiatric complications of infectious and inflammatory conditions.
